g.text: HIGH-LEVEL DESIGN (HLD): FINOPS FOR THE AGENTIC HARNESS
System Architecture for Eliminating the Hidden Costs of Non-Functional LLM Calls: Guardrails, Memory Consolidation & Evals
Runs once at session close (not per turn)
• Pinned Static Prefix = Automatic Cache Hit
• Model: GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Gemini 1.5 Pro
Direct user business logic and answer delivery
• Max Trajectory Hops: Hard cap at 5 steps
• Leaky Bucket Token Budget: $0.05 / turn cap
• Runaway Loop Killer: Halts repetitive failures
Deterministic fallback gracefully returns to user
FINOPS UNIT ECONOMICS & COST EQUATION BREAKDOWN
Cost Equation: C_total = C_functional + C_guardrails(SLM) + C_memory(Tier2) + C_evals(Async 5%) + C_prefix_caching(-80%)
